basic_profile.bio: Avid Pokémon Go player and community organizer living in Ann Arbor, Michigan. I enjoy coordinating raids and trading sessions in my area. Outside of Pokémon, I'm a firearms enthusiast and a fan of indie RPGs, especially 'Sea of Stars'. Usually online during the evenings and weekends, balancing my time between work as a software engineer and my hobbies. In a long-term relationship with a fellow Pokémon Go trainer.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught Pokémon Go expert with extensive knowledge from years of playing and participating in online forums. Developed a keen interest in indie games and firearms through personal research and community engagement.
